name: Aarti Surfactants Ltd
tagline: Demerged specialty-surfactants maker with a real recent-quarter profit inflection off a weak base - a low-conviction, unconfirmed 10x-optionality watch
business_overview: Aarti Surfactants was formed by the demerger of the Home & Personal Care division of Aarti Industries. It makes ionic and non-ionic surfactants and specialty/formulated blends for shampoos, soaps, handwash, detergents and cleaners, plus industrial, agro and oil-industry applications, from plants at Pithampur (MP) and Silvassa.
fundamentals_table: Q2 FY26: sales +6.5% YoY, net profit +114.8% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Trailing metrics are weak - ROE ~5%, ROCE ~8.5%, a negative multi-year profit trend - but the recent quarter shows a sharp, specific improvement: Q2 FY26 net profit up ~115% YoY on modest ~6.5% sales growth, with working-capital days cut by a third. This is a margin-normalisation / operating-leverage story off a low base, consistent with a demerged commodity-to-specialty transition, not yet a proven compounding trend.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock well off its 52-week high of Rs 680.
sentiment_summary: The dedicated ValuePickr thread (topic 132910) is effectively dead - three substantive intro posts from Jan 2024 and then a moderator note about forum guidelines; no ongoing discussion, no thesis debate, no conviction calls. This assessment therefore rests on the fundamentals and the recent-quarter inflection.

track_record.note: Screener FY21-FY25: never had both rev growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15% in the same year - ROCE structurally sub-15 (range 7-15%), and the one 15% ROCE year (FY23) had only 4% growth. 0 of 5 cleared.

quality_metrics.note: ROCE volatile and low (13/7/11/15/8/9% FY20-25); OPM contracted 11%->6%->5% FY24-26. Borrowings Rs104cr FY26 vs ~Rs43cr EBITDA (~2.4x); FY26 interest cover only ~1.4x (PBT Rs17cr / interest Rs12cr). Trailing-3y FCF conversion ~+40% only because capex was starved (Rs16-46cr/yr) - not a quality signal given ROCE <10% and margins falling, so capex reads value-destructive.
